notToBeConfusedWith.name: Pineapple juice
notToBeConfusedWith.note: The pressed juice, sold and used separately; a recipe naming the whole fruit means it as a garnish or a cut piece, not something poured.

forms.label: Whole, raw
forms.sourceNote: Pineapple, raw, all varieties. Public domain. The one-fruit weight (905 g) is the record's own whole-fruit portion. No density is carried: a pineapple is not poured, and where a recipe uses only a wedge for garnish the line states how little of the fruit reaches the drink.
